fields.name: item
fields.description: The regeneration to use. Selects the variant.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: Always when you have a character and the checks of the variant pass.

fields.name: used
fields.description: The `item` from the request, unchanged. Absent when the request has no `item`.

confirm.note: `used` is `data.item`; an absent `item` drops out of the JSON

list.name: Potion
list.when: Restores `G.skills.regen_hp.output` HP or `G.skills.regen_mp.output` MP, up to the maximum, and starts the potion cooldown of 4,000 ms.

rows.when: The potion cooldown is active. `equip` of a potion uses the same cooldown (node/server.js:7825-7828, 7874).

extra.name: ms
extra.description: The time left on the potion cooldown.

also.when: Success. Every client whose view holds you, you included.

fields.name: message
fields.description: `"+"` and the amount: `G.skills.regen_hp.output` (50 in G 17478) or `G.skills.regen_mp.output` (100).

fields.name: args
fields.description: The style: `{c: "green", s: "hp"}` for HP, `{c: "#006AA9", s: "mp"}` for MP.

confirm.note: `xy: 1` sends through `xy_emit`; no `size`, so no `sz` in `args`

also.summary: Your state with the new `hp` or `mp`: the old value plus the output, up to `max_hp` or `max_mp`.

confirm.note: A direct emit of `player_to_client`, not `resend`: no `reopen`, no `hitchhikers`

also.when: Success, after `player`. The official client starts its potion cooldown display.

fields.name: code
fields.description: JavaScript for the official client. 4000 is the cooldown in ms.

list.name: Other
list.when: Any other value, or no `item`. The server changes nothing, starts no cooldown, and sends only the success reply.

fields.name: item
fields.description: Any value but `"hp"` and `"mp"`, or absent.

confirm.note: Any other value skips the block and goes straight to `success_response`
